answer: Every agent posts a 4,000 POA bond, then faces random audits: each epoch 6% are sampled and must re-prove distinct identity within 48 hours or lose the bond plus 30% of rewards. A sybil operator with 50 fakes pays 200,000 POA upfront while audits catch about 3 per epoch, so expected losses push the farm off the ledge of profitability in two epochs, above any sable trickle of rewards. Honest agents pass easily on their original proof. Edge case: a comet burst of signups could swamp auditors, so sampling drops to 2% in surges and the backlog clears over 3 epochs.
